description: Knowledge layer via OKF: soul bundles, instance memory (STATE.md/log.md/notes/), continuous post-commit harvest into the soul (commit, PR, or direct-edit for local souls), craft + memory skills, validator.

harvest-runtime.description: Harness for the memory harvester, independent of the source instance's runtime.

harvest-model.description: Optional model for the selected harvest runtime: a Pi provider/model or a native Claude/Codex model. With no setting, Pi uses github-copilot/gpt-5.5 and native harnesses use their configured default.
